decisions.reason: Changing the basket-weave diamond scale does not alter the independently defined Zebra print. The Zebra palette change in the same message is already represented by its own MODIFY.
Selecting the 7.5 cm basket-weave scale does not change production readiness, CMYK mode, or seamless-repeat file requirements.
The basket-weave scale selection does not change the mustard block-colour pareo's design, colour, or border requirements.
The basket-weave scale selection does not change the terracotta or burgundy block-colour pareo's design, colour reference, or border.
The basket-weave scale selection does not alter the fabric, Pantone, visual-approximation, or ICC-profile calibration requirements.
